semantics.sampling: Sample in on rising clk edges, assuming conventional positive-edge clocking because the text does not specify an edge.
semantics.reset: Original: asynchronously reset into state B if reset is high. Assert areset asynchronously; while high, B dominates each clock edge. Deassertion alone does not transition state.
semantics.output: Moore output is determined by current state without an extra output register or cycle latency.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; no initialization is added. Functional checks begin after an asserted reset.

numeric.port_widths: All ports are one bit as explicitly specified
numeric.state_storage: One bit encodes A=0 and B=1
numeric.arithmetic: No numeric arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent named-state transition table taken directly from the original diagram
verification.sampling_phase: Check one time unit after rising clock or reset assertion to allow nonblocking updates
coverage: Reset deassertion and input changes without a rising clock
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation timeout with fatal failure
verification.pass: PASS only after all comparisons complete

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use rising edge clk; conventional clocked FSM assumption, no conflicting original evidence

specification_ambiguities.issue: Power-up state and unknown input behavior unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not prescribe initial state or X/Z input behavior; verify binary inputs after reset
